speaker: Shmuley Boteach
review: The complete single-speaker audio response corroborates the proposed delayed recognition of birth, the age-eighty proposal, species-centered ethics, and the forced-sterilization example. Francis Crick, Bentley Glass, Tay-Sachs, and Oliver Wendell Holmes are recoverable, while the Spartan mountain name remains transcription-imperfect and should not be quoted. The two frozen quotation choices are corroborated. Boteach explicitly identifies the quoted pregnancy passage as concerning miscarriages; his subsequent euthanasia question is a challenge to the opponent, not an endorsement of killing disabled children. Retain that argumentative context and his later clarifying concession in the full source. The audio confirms what was asserted, not the accuracy of these historical attributions.
